engineering_correction: Coalesce null optional rights_ratio to zero exactly as canonical finite_or_default semantics require; no lineage, feature, gate, population, or interpretation change.
question: Does V1's exact canonical minimum-volume session define reproducible neutral support-defense and recovery lineages before outcomes are inspected?
mechanism: The lowest-volume session in the canonical t-30..t-1 window is a strategy-native supply-dry-up anchor. A defended anchor low followed by recovery above its close represents a different prebreakout structure from an undercut or unrecovered anchor.

population.qualification: Accepted completed V1 entries, bounded PIT-B; only identity columns may be projected from the outcome-bearing accepted-cycle table.

canonical_anchor.volume_coordinate: canonical signal-time coordinate; each visible valid share multiplier rebases only earlier historical volumes
canonical_anchor.minimum_tie_rule: earliest session among exactly tied minimum volumes, matching Python min(range(30), key=volume)
canonical_anchor.canonical_admission: minimum-volume close location <=0.50 and minimum/mean volume <=0.70

primary_axes.low_support_held: every later t-30..t-1 adjusted low is greater than or equal to the anchor adjusted low; an anchor at t-1 is vacuously held
primary_axes.recovered_above_anchor_close: t-1 adjusted close is strictly greater than the anchor adjusted close
primary_axes.natural_boundaries: exact support equality and zero close recovery; no selected thresholds

neutral_lineages.L00_LOW_BROKEN_NOT_RECOVERED: anchor low broken and t-1 not above anchor close
neutral_lineages.L01_LOW_BROKEN_RECOVERED: anchor low broken and t-1 above anchor close
neutral_lineages.L10_LOW_HELD_NOT_RECOVERED: anchor low held and t-1 not above anchor close
neutral_lineages.L11_LOW_HELD_RECOVERED: anchor low held and t-1 above anchor close

fixed_neighbor.close_support_held: replace anchor-low/later-low defense with every later close greater than or equal to the anchor close; recovery axis unchanged
fixed_neighbor.purpose: test whether support lineage survives a close-based rather than intraday-low support coordinate

decision.FREEZE_LINEAGE: all 399 canonical anchors reconcile and pass, all four classes satisfy size/year gates, low/close support assignment agreement reaches 65%, and no outcome field enters
decision.REJECT_BEFORE_OUTCOME: canonical reconciliation, coverage, class balance, temporal presence, neighboring support stability, PIT, or outcome-prohibition gate fails

outcome_prohibition: holding duration, holding path, or exit
winner, loser, severe-loss, or right-tail class
outcome-guided class merge, relabeling, or support definition

interpretation_boundary.if_frozen: A freeze authorizes only a separately preregistered outcome reveal, not an economic claim.
forbidden: minimum-volume age or support-distance threshold search
choosing low or close support after construction
entry, exit, sizing, overlay, or production rule
